第四十八章 龙圣镇世诀断根逆天劫（第1页）
万世护生大阵稳稳笼罩万里山河，柔光澄澈，隔绝了天外杀伐戾气，让人间烟火安然无恙。
始祖悬浮血色天幕中央，半实体血躯煞气滔天，眼底尽是阴戾嘲弄。
他看得一清二楚，方才二人仓促布下护生大阵，强行透支了人圣共生本源。
此刻他们的力量看似磅礴，实则根基空虚，本源耗损过半，正是最虚弱的时刻。
“自耗根基护蝼蚁苍生？愚蠢至极！”
始祖冷笑抬手，虚空之中，第四重天劫纹路彻底亮起，漆黑暗沉的劫光贯穿天地，带着斩断万物根本的肃杀之气轰然坠落！
此劫不斩肉身，不破神魂，专断修士道基、绝天地本源！
断圣脉之根，断龙气之基，断人圣共生的万古羁绊根本！
漫天漆黑劫丝如万载寒钉，穿透血色云层，精准锁定王府之中的两道身影，凛冽杀机窒息万古！
历代圣女从未熬过此劫，但凡踏入断根劫者，圣脉尽数崩碎，神魂剥离天道，最终沦为废人，凄惨陨落。
而今日，这本无解的断根天罚，尽数压在沈清鸢与萧聿辞身上。
萧聿辞瞬间凝神，透过共生神魂，与她心念彻底互通。
两人气息相融、灵力互通、本源互补，一金一白两道光芒冲天而起，周身纹路交织缠绕，演化出万古从未现世的绝世神通！
自人圣双魂绑定之后，属于他们的专属终极神通——龙圣镇世诀，首次逆天现世！
金光霸道镇山河，圣光温柔渡万古。
两道极致力量相融相撞，化作一面横跨天地的金银巨盾，稳稳挡在漫天断根劫光之前！
天罚轰然砸落，万古规则碾压巨盾，天地巨震，虚空炸裂！
黑色劫力疯狂侵蚀盾面，密密麻麻的裂纹瞬间蔓延整片光壁，断根之力试图强行剥离二人相融的本源根基。
剧痛同时席卷两人身心，经脉震颤，本源翻涌，方才布阵透支的伤势彻底爆发。
萧聿辞龙根旧伤复发，心口一阵撕裂剧痛，喉间腥甜翻涌不止。
沈清鸢圣脉震荡，指尖发白，浑身灵力几近枯竭。
一人为护苍生，一人为护挚爱，双双咬牙硬扛万古天罚！
二人同声厉喝，共生之力彻底暴走！
金银巨盾骤然绽放万丈霞光，反向碾压漫天劫力！
原本霸道无解的断根天道规则，在人圣共生的逆天神通之下，被层层瓦解、碾碎、消融！
漆黑劫丝寸寸溃散，贯穿天地的断根天威，硬生生被两人正面击溃！
长空之上的始祖彻底怔住，满脸难以置信的癫狂错愕。
“本源透支、道基受损，你们本该无力御劫！”
“区区人间男女，凭什么连续破碎四重万古天劫！”
他筹谋万载，熟知天道每一重劫罚的杀伐规则，笃定断根劫必能断其根基。
却万万没想到，人圣共生的羁绊之力，早已超脱天道规则！
这是万古天道永远算不透、永远掌控不了的变数！
沈清鸢轻喘倚靠在萧聿辞怀中，眉眼虽倦，却傲骨凛然：
“你懂天道规则，算尽天地棋局。”
“可你永远不懂，何为并肩，何为守护，何为双向逆命。”
萧聿辞稳稳拥着她，抬手抹去她唇角细碎血痕，眼底温柔藏锋芒：
“天道可断万物，唯断不了你我羁绊。”
始祖被这句话彻底激怒，血色半体剧烈震颤，戾气暴涨万丈：
“四重劫不灭你们，那本座便引第五重绝念天劫！”
“我倒要看看，你们的深情羁绊，能不能扛得住万古心魔噬心！”
九天劫云再度暴涨，更深、更阴冷的灰色劫力悄然凝聚。

Chapter 48: Dragon Saint’s World-Suppressing Technique to Cut Off the Roots and Defy the Heaven-defying Tribulation (Page 1)
The eternal life-protecting formation firmly covers thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, with soft and clear light, blocking out the murderous and violent energy from outside, making the fireworks in the world safe and sound.
The First Ancestor was suspended in the center of the bloody sky, his semi-corporeal blood body filled with evil aura, and his eyes were full of sinister mockery.
He could see clearly that just now the two of them hastily set up a large formation to protect the students, forcibly overdrawing the origin of the symbiosis between humans and saints.
At this moment, their strength seems to be majestic, but in fact, it has an empty foundation. More than half of its origin has been depleted, which is the moment when they are at their weakest.
"Consuming your own foundation to protect the common people? How stupid!"
The ancestor raised his hand with a sneer, and in the void, the fourth level of heavenly calamity patterns completely lit up. The dark calamity light penetrated the heaven and earth, and crashed down with a chilling aura that cut off the roots of all things!
This calamity will not destroy the physical body, nor destroy the soul, but will arbitrarily determine the foundation of the monks and destroy the origin of heaven and earth!
Cut off the roots of the holy veins, cut off the foundation of the dragon energy, and cut off the eternal bond of symbiosis between humans and saints!
The black threads of calamity in the sky are like nails that have been cold for thousands of years, penetrating the blood-colored clouds and accurately targeting the two figures in the palace. The cold murderous intent will suffocate for eternity!
Saints throughout the ages have never survived this calamity, but whoever steps into the root-cutting calamity will have all their holy veins shattered, their souls stripped of the heavenly path, and eventually they will become useless and die miserably.
But today, this unexplainable natural punishment is all on Shen Qingyuan and Xiao Yuci.
Xiao Yuci concentrated for a moment, and through the symbiotic soul, his thoughts were completely connected with hers.
The breaths of the two people blended together, their spiritual powers communicated, and their origins complemented each other. Two rays of light, one gold and one white, rose into the sky, and the lines on their bodies were intertwined, evolving into a peerless magical power that had never appeared in the world before!
Since the two souls of the Human Saint were bound, their exclusive ultimate magical power - the Dragon Saint's World-Suppressing Art, has appeared for the first time against the heavens!
The golden light dominates the mountains and rivers, and the holy light gently flows through the ages.
The two extreme powers merged and collided, turning into a giant shield of gold and silver across the sky and the earth, firmly blocking the sky and the tribulation light!
The heavenly punishment crashed down, the eternal rules crushed the giant shield, the heaven and earth shook violently, and the void exploded!
The black tribulation force crazily eroded the shield surface, and dense cracks instantly spread across the entire light wall. The root-cutting force tried to forcibly peel off the original foundation of the two people's fusion.
Severe pain swept through the two people's bodies and minds at the same time, their meridians trembled, their origins surged, and the injuries that had just been overdrawn completely exploded.
Xiao Yuci's old injury to Long Gen recurred, and there was a sharp tearing pain in his heart, and a fishy and sweet taste surged in his throat.
Shen Qingyuan's holy veins vibrated, his fingertips turned white, and his whole body's spiritual energy was almost exhausted.
One person protects the common people, the other person protects his beloved, both of them grit their teeth and bear the eternal punishment!
The two of them shouted in unison, and the symbiotic power completely went berserk!
The giant gold and silver shield suddenly burst into rays of light, crushing the sky with catastrophic force!
The originally overbearing and unsolvable rules of cutting off the law of heaven were disintegrated, crushed, and dissolved layer by layer under the heaven-defying magical power of symbiosis between humans and saints!
The dark threads of calamity disintegrated inch by inch, and the powerful force of heaven that penetrated the heaven and earth was defeated by the two of them head-on!
The ancestor above the sky was completely stunned, his face full of disbelief and madness.
"The source is overdrawn and the Dao foundation is damaged. You should be unable to resist the disaster!"
"How come a mere human man and woman can continuously shatter four levels of eternal tribulation!"
He has been planning for thousands of years, and is familiar with the killing rules of every tribulation and punishment of heaven. He is determined that if the root tribulation is eliminated, its foundation will be cut off.
But he never expected that the power of the symbiosis between humans and saints has already transcended the rules of heaven!
This is a variable that eternal heaven can never calculate and can never control!
Shen Qingyuan panted lightly and leaned in Xiao Yuci's arms. Although her eyes and eyebrows were tired, they were proud and awe-inspiring:
"You understand the rules of heaven and can calculate the chessboards of heaven and earth."
"But you never understand what it means to be side by side, what it means to protect, and what it means to go against fate in both directions."
Xiao Yuci hugged her firmly, raised his hand to wipe away the tiny blood stains on the corners of her lips, his eyes were gentle but sharp:
"The way of heaven can break all things, but it can't break the bond between you and me."
The ancestor was completely angered by these words, his bloody body trembled violently, and his anger surged:
"If the fourth level of calamity cannot destroy you, then I will trigger the fifth level of ultimate calamity!"
"I want to see if your affectionate bond can withstand the eternal demons that gnaw at your heart!"
The nine-day calamity cloud surged again, and the deeper and colder gray calamity power quietly condensed.
